<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inform" name="Employee notifies employer of accident"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReportAccident" name="Accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReportInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReportPrivate" name="Written report to private insurer"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="StartEvent_EmployeeNotified" messageRef="Message_Inform"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportInsurer" name="Accident report" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_ReportAccident"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatality or serious injury" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_ReportInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportPrivate" name="Written accident report" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_ReportPrivate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AccidentOccurred" name="Accident or near-accident occurred">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccidentToAssess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AssessAccident" name="Assess whether work accident or near-accident">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccidentToAssess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessToReportGw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportSplit" name="Work accident or near-accident?" default="Flow_NoReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessToReportGw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReportYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoReport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately" messageRef="Message_Inform">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReportYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InformToPrivateGw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateSplit" name="Private insurance applies?" default="Flow_NoPrivate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InformToPrivateGw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrivateYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoPrivate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivate" name="Report accident in writing to private insurer" messageRef="Message_ReportPrivate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrivateYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrivateReportedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoReport" name="No report required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoReport</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_EmployerInformed" name="Employer informed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoPrivate</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateReported" name="Private insurer reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrivateReportedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccidentToAssess" sourceRef="StartEvent_AccidentOccurred" targetRef="UserTask_AssessAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessToReportGw" sourceRef="UserTask_AssessAccident" targetRef="Gateway_ReportSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportSplit" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReport" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_NoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformToPrivateGw" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateSplit" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPrivate" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_EmployerInformed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReportedToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_EmployeeNotified" name="Employee accident notification received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifiedToRecord</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_EmployeeNotified" messageRef="Message_Inform"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_RecordAccident" name="Record accident details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifiedToRecord</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordToSeverity</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SeveritySplit" name="Fatality or serious injury?" default="Flow_NotSevere">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordToSeverity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Severe</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotSevere</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencySplit" name="Already reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_NotReportedEmergency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Severe</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmergencyYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotReportedEmergency</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately" messageRef="Message_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReportedEmergency</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InspectToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SeverityMerge" name="">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotSevere</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmergencyYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InspectToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToInsurerSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurerSplit" name="Killed or unable to work for three days?" default="Flow_NoInsurerReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToInsurerSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurerYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInsurerReport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days" messageRef="Message_ReportAccident">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurerYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurerReportedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InsurerReported" name="Accident insurer reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurerReportedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport" name="No insurer report required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInsurerReport</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifiedToRecord" sourceRef="StartEvent_EmployeeNotified" targetRef="UserTask_RecordAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToSeverity" sourceRef="UserTask_RecordAccident" targetRef="Gateway_SeveritySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Severe" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SeveritySplit" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSevere" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SeveritySplit" targetRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencySplit" targetRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReportedEmergency" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencySplit" targetRef="SendTask_ReportInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToInsurerSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_SeverityMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InsurerSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerSplit" targetRef="SendTask_ReportInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInsurerReport" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_NoInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportedToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_InsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
